title: Cross-Section Estimation of Long-Run Relations Using Time-Compressed Data
title_primary: Cross-Section Estimation of Long-Run Relations Using Time-Compressed Data
authors: Serena Ng, Nikolay Gospodinov
official: 官方在线 2026-09-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Many empirical investigations of long-run relations are based on cross-section regressions in averaged or long differenced data that effectively have the time dimension of a T × N panel compressed. We analyze a class of time-compressed I(1) data and show that they have magnified variability stemming from the fact that the cross-section variance of a non-stationary panel ‘fans out’ with time. Cross-section regressions in time compressed data can potentially yield estimates that are super-consistent and asymptotically normal, whether the regressors are stationary, non-stationary, or highly persistent. The fastest convergence rate of √NT requires a compression scheme that not only magnifies the non-stationary signal, but also dilutes the regression noise. Omitted fixed effects preclude noise dilution but the estimates remain superconsistent. However, the fanning out effect can be weakened when the data have a strong force for mean-reversion or convergence, a problem that seems relevant for temperature data. We consider three applications and find that the long-run relation between consumption and income, and between growth/inflation and demographic variables are reasonably well determined, but the estimated relation between growth and warming temperature is fragile.

title: Free to choose: Bank capital in Britain, 1878–1939
title_zh: 自由选择：英国银行资本，1878–1939
title_primary: 自由选择：英国银行资本，1878–1939
title_secondary: Free to choose: Bank capital in Britain, 1878–1939
authors: Gareth Campbell, Lyndon Moore, John D. Turner
official: 官方在线 2026-09-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Government regulation of the banking sector is pervasive, making it difficult to empirically analyse when banks would voluntarily choose to issue equity if there were no minimum requirements on capital adequacy. A unique historical setting occurred in the late nineteenth‐century United Kingdom when joint‐stock banks were free to choose their capital structures. We show that during this era, banks were willing to issue equity as part of restructuring processes, but were reluctant to do so on a regular basis to offset increases in liabilities. We find that large issues of uncalled capital were made as a replacement for unlimited liability, and this uncalled capital continued to restrain risk‐taking as shown by an analysis of bank loan books. Banks were also willing to issue stock to finance mergers and acquisitions, but this was generally just used to absorb the equity of target banks so did not increase aggregate paid‐up capital. Equity issuance did not keep pace with deposit growth, leading to the erosion of capital adequacy over the long run.
abstract_zh: 政府对银行业的监管无处不在，这使得在缺乏最低资本充足率要求的情况下，难以实证分析银行何时会自愿选择发行股票。十九世纪末的英国出现了一个独特的历史背景，当时股份制银行可以自由选择其资本结构。我们表明，在那个时代，银行愿意在重组过程中发行股票，但不愿定期这样做以抵消负债的增加。我们发现，大量未缴资本的发行是为了替代无限责任，而这种未缴资本通过银行贷款账簿的分析显示，持续抑制了风险承担。银行也愿意发行股票以资助并购活动，但这通常仅用于吸收目标银行的股权，因此并未增加总实缴资本。股票发行未能跟上存款增长的步伐，导致资本充足率在长期内逐渐侵蚀。

title: Merger or acquisition? An introduction to the Handbook of Historical economics
title_zh: 并购还是收购？《历史经济学手册》导论
title_primary: 并购还是收购？《历史经济学手册》导论
title_secondary: Merger or acquisition? An introduction to the Handbook of Historical economics
authors: Alberto Bisin, Giovanni Federico
official: 官方在线 2021-02-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The relationship between history and economics as academic disciplines is methodologically subtle and sociologically contested. If the Cliometric revolution can be characterized as an acquisition of economics by history, the most recent trends in Historical Economics appear to turn this relationship on its head. In this Introduction we read the chapters of the Handbook as a forceful argument in favor of a merger between the two disciplines rather than the acquisition of one by the other; a merger which combines, notably, the detailed knowledge of historical sources, the capability of distilling complex historical processes into a model, and the statistical/econometric skills for identification and estimation.
abstract_zh: 历史与经济学作为学科之间的关系，在方法论上微妙且在社会学上备受争议。如果说计量历史学革命可被描述为历史对经济学的吸纳，那么历史经济学的最新趋势似乎颠覆了这一关系。在本引言中，我们将《手册》的各章节解读为支持两学科合并而非一方吸纳另一方的有力论据；这一合并尤其结合了对历史资料的详尽了解、将复杂历史过程提炼为模型的能力，以及用于识别和估计的统计/计量经济学技能。

title: Measuring Science: Performance Metrics and the Allocation of Talent
title_zh: 衡量科学：绩效指标与人才配置
title_primary: 衡量科学：绩效指标与人才配置

authors: Sebastian Hager, Carlo Schwarz, Fabian Waldinger
official: 官方在线 2023-06-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study how performance metrics affect the allocation of talent by exploiting the introduction of the first citation database in science. For technical reasons, it only covered citations from certain journals and years, creating quasi-random variation: some citations became visible, while others remained invisible. We identify the effects of citation metrics by comparing the predictiveness of visible to invisible citations. Citation metrics increased assortative matching between scientists and departments by reducing information frictions over geographic and intellectual distance. Highly cited scientists from lower-ranked departments (“hidden stars”) and from minorities benefited more. Citation metrics also affected promotions and NSF grants, suggesting Matthew effects. (JEL A14, I23, J44)
abstract_zh: 我们通过利用首个科学引文数据库的引入，探讨了绩效指标如何影响人才配置。由于技术原因，该数据库仅覆盖了特定期刊和年份的引文，从而产生了准随机变异：部分引文变得可见，而其他引文则保持不可见。我们通过比较可见引文与不可见引文的预测能力，来识别引文指标的影响。引文指标通过减少地理和智力距离上的信息摩擦，增强了科学家与院系之间的选配匹配。来自排名较低院系的高被引科学家（“隐藏明星”）及少数族裔科学家受益更多。引文指标还影响了晋升和NSF资助，表明存在马太效应。（JEL A14, I23, J44）

title: When exports decelerate: The mental health consequences of China’s export slowdown
title_zh: 当出口减速：中国出口放缓的心理健康后果
title_primary: 当出口减速：中国出口放缓的心理健康后果
title_secondary: When exports decelerate: The mental health consequences of China’s export slowdown
authors: Chuan He, Yuting Li, Hong Ma, Mingzhi (Jimmy) Xu
official: 官方在线 2026-08-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines the mental health consequences of China’s export slowdown from 2010 to 2016. Using nationally representative individual-level panel data and a shift-share instrument for city-level export exposure, we find that export slowdown significantly increased psychological distress. The effects are most pronounced in export-reliant regions and among middle-aged, less-educated individuals, production and manufacturing workers, and married women. We further show that export slowdowns operate through both level and distributional channels: they deteriorate labor market conditions and widen income inequality. At the household level, export slowdowns increase reliance on short-term borrowing, amplifying forward-looking financial stress, particularly for families with young children. Institutional and technological forces shape these impacts: stronger local social safety nets mitigate mental distress among vulnerable groups, while accelerated workplace automation exacerbates stress for employed workers. A one-standard-deviation decline in export exposure is associated with 44,686 disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) and mental health-related costs equivalent to 0.34% of China’s GDP in 2013. These findings reveal the uneven psychological costs of adverse trade shocks and highlight the importance of distribution-sensitive trade adjustment policies.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了2010至2016年间中国出口放缓对心理健康的影响。利用具有全国代表性的个体层面面板数据及针对城市出口暴露度的转移份额工具变量，我们发现出口放缓显著加剧了心理困扰。这一效应在依赖出口的地区以及中年、受教育程度较低个体、生产与制造业工人及已婚女性中最为突出。我们进一步表明，出口放缓通过水平与分配双重渠道发挥作用：既恶化了劳动力市场状况，又扩大了收入不平等。在家庭层面，出口放缓增加了对短期借贷的依赖，加剧了前瞻性财务压力，尤其对育有幼儿的家庭影响显著。制度与技术力量塑造了这些影响：更强大的地方社会安全网缓解了弱势群体的心理困扰，而工作场所自动化的加速则加剧了在职员工的心理压力。出口暴露度每下降一个标准差，与2013年中国44，686个伤残调整生命年及相当于GDP 0.34%的心理健康相关成本相关联。这些发现揭示了不利贸易冲击带来的不均衡心理成本，并强调了注重分配效应的贸易调整政策的重要性。

title: A re‐examination of the competitive effects of exclusive dealing
title_zh: 独家交易的竞争效应再考察
title_primary: 独家交易的竞争效应再考察
title_secondary: A re‐examination of the competitive effects of exclusive dealing
authors: Guofu Tan, Adam C.L. Wong
official: 官方在线 2026-08-16 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The seminal 1987 paper by Mathewson and Winter demonstrates that the competitive effects of exclusive dealing depend on firm asymmetries. Revisiting their model with linear demand and constant marginal costs, we show that the equilibrium adoption and welfare impact of exclusive dealing are fully characterized by two sufficient statistics: the standalone surplus ratio (capturing the dominant firm's competitive advantage) and the geometric mean of demand diversion ratios (measuring product substitutability). Exclusive dealing is more likely to arise and harm consumer surplus when competitive advantage is stronger and products are closer substitutes. A stronger competitive advantage also raises the likelihood that exclusive dealing reduces social welfare, while the effect of substitutability on welfare is non‐monotonic. We also show that both competitive advantage and substitutability can be empirically recovered from diversion ratios and market shares under the no‐exclusive dealing regime.
abstract_zh: Mathewson和Winter在1987年的开创性论文表明，排他性交易的竞争效应取决于企业的不对称性。通过在线性需求和恒定边际成本下重新审视其模型，我们证明排他性交易的均衡采纳及其福利影响完全由两个充分统计量刻画：独立剩余比率（反映主导企业的竞争优势）和需求转移率的几何平均值（衡量产品替代性）。当竞争优势更强且产品更接近替代品时，排他性交易更可能发生并损害消费者剩余。更强的竞争优势也提高了排他性交易降低社会福利的可能性，而替代性对福利的影响则是非单调的。我们还表明，在无排他性交易制度下，竞争优势和替代性均可通过转移率和市场份额进行实证估计。

title: A DSGE Model for a Small Open Economy with a CBDC Option
title_zh: 具有央行数字货币选项的小型开放经济体的DSGE模型
title_primary: 具有央行数字货币选项的小型开放经济体的DSGE模型
title_secondary: A DSGE Model for a Small Open Economy with a CBDC Option
authors: Michael Kumhof, Mohammed Mikou, Yassine Slaoui
official: 官方在线 2026-08-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper develops a small open economy DSGE model for central bank policy analysis. The model’s structure and calibration are based on the Moroccan economy, but with minor modifications the same model can be applied to many other economies. The framework features two household groups, banked households who have access to cash but also to credit and therefore to deposits as medium of exchange, and unbanked households who rely exclusively on cash. Households interact with banks, financial investors, firms, unions, a fiscal authority, a central bank, and the external sector. The model can be simulated either with or without a retail CBDC, which is introduced as an additional payment instrument alongside cash and bank deposits. A central mechanism is the interaction between real decisions and payment frictions. Consumption- and production-related payments are subject to money-in-advance constraints, where money or liquidity is a composite of cash, deposits, and—when activated—CBDC. Any scarcity of money therefore affects spending, marginal costs and inflation, while credit frictions connect collateral quality and default risk to the scarcity of money. The paper finds that the introduction of CBDC causes modest steady state output gains and modest improvements in the economy’s ability to deal with financial shocks.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个适用于中央银行政策分析的小型开放经济DSGE模型。模型的结构与校准基于摩洛哥经济，但经过小幅调整，同一模型可应用于众多其他经济体。该框架包含两类家庭群体：一类是拥有银行账户的家庭，他们既能使用现金，也能获得信贷，并将存款作为交易媒介；另一类是无银行账户的家庭，他们仅依赖现金进行交易。家庭与银行、金融投资者、企业、工会、财政当局、中央银行及外部部门之间存在互动关系。模型可在引入或不引入零售中央银行数字货币（CBDC）的情况下进行模拟，该CBDC作为除现金和银行存款之外的额外支付工具被引入。核心机制在于实际决策与支付摩擦之间的相互作用。与消费和生产相关的支付受到现金预付约束的限制，其中货币或流动性由现金、存款以及（若启用时）CBDC共同构成。因此，任何货币短缺都会影响支出、边际成本和通货膨胀，而信贷摩擦则将抵押品质量及违约风险与货币短缺联系起来。本文发现，引入CBDC会带来适度的稳态产出增益，并适度提升经济体应对金融冲击的能力。

title: Designing Around Selection: Identification and Inference Under Multi-Dimensional Unobserved Heterogeneity
title_zh: 围绕选择的设计：多维不可观测异质性下的识别与推断
title_primary: 围绕选择的设计：多维不可观测异质性下的识别与推断
title_secondary: Designing Around Selection: Identification and Inference Under Multi-Dimensional Unobserved Heterogeneity
authors: Brent R. Hickman, John A. List, Ian Muir, Gregory K. Sun
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study identification and optimal policy design in a broad class of principal-agent models. We show that the most common empirical framework within the literature is equivalent to an unstructured potential-outcomes model augmented with three specific assumptions: the Law of Demand (LoD), or treatment-effect monotonicity; extrapolative model structure (EMS), which rules out lumpy agent responses to price changes; and rank invariance (RI), which restricts unobserved heterogeneity (UH) to be one-dimensional. This decomposition isolates the identifying content of each assumption and clarifies its economic role. The LoD and MS are empirically testable using exogenous price variation; RI, on the other hand, is a strong assumption ruling out many economically plausible behaviors, and also not empirically testable. We derive sharp bounds on counterfactual outcomes when RI is relaxed. The conventional 1-dimensional model delivers an upper bound on planner objectives, while the lower bound, which allows for arbitrary multi-dimensional UH, has an adversarial interpretation for policy design. We estimate empirical bounds and apply them to nonlinear pricing of rideshare services. The resulting robust pricing policy fully insures against worst-case latent selection while preserving most of the profit and consumer-surplus gains predicted by the conventional model. Our framework provides a tractable approach to robust policy design in adverse-selection settings including Mirrleesian taxation, regulation, labor supply, and procurement.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一类广泛的委托-代理模型中的识别与最优政策设计问题。我们证明，该文献中最常见的实证框架等价于一个非结构化的潜在结果模型，并附加了三个特定假设：需求定律（LoD），即处理效应单调性；外推模型结构（EMS），排除了代理人对价格变化的非连续响应；以及秩不变性（RI），将未观测异质性（UH）限制为一维。这一分解隔离了每个假设的识别内容，并阐明了其经济作用。需求定律和模型结构可利用外生价格变动进行实证检验；而秩不变性则是一个强假设，排除了许多经济上合理的行为，且无法进行实证检验。我们在放宽秩不变性时推导出反事实结果的尖锐边界。传统的一维模型提供了规划者目标的上界，而下界允许任意多维未观测异质性，对政策设计具有对抗性解释。我们估计了实证边界，并将其应用于网约车服务的非线性定价。由此产生的稳健定价政策完全对冲了最坏情况下的潜在选择，同时保留了传统模型预测的大部分利润和消费者剩余收益。我们的框架为逆向选择环境中的稳健政策设计提供了一种易处理的方法，包括米尔利斯式税收、规制、劳动供给和采购等领域。

title: Urban expansion, informality and climate change in intermediate cities in Latin America and the Caribbean: Challenges and opportunities
title_zh: 拉丁美洲和加勒比地区中等城市的城市扩张、非正规性与气候变化：挑战与机遇
title_primary: 拉丁美洲和加勒比地区中等城市的城市扩张、非正规性与气候变化：挑战与机遇
title_secondary: Urban expansion, informality and climate change in intermediate cities in Latin America and the Caribbean: Challenges and opportunities
authors: Jobssuel Alexander Eusebio Alvarez, Eric Gielen, José-Sergio Palencia-Jiménez
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The lack of urban planning in Latin America’s medium-sized cities, especially in the Caribbean, has resulted in uncontrolled expansion with severe implications in the context of climate emergencies. This expansion manifests through two intertwined processes: “urban sprawl,” understood as outward, land‑consuming (often low‑density) growth, and “informal settlements,” referring to residential areas developed outside formal planning, regulatory, or tenure frameworks. Although analytically distinct, both dynamics frequently overlap in intermediate Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC), where peripheral growth is predominantly driven by informal urbanisation. These cities/urban peripheries are highly vulnerable and urgently need to integrate the climate dimension into their urban development strategies. This paper analyses the scientific and grey literature published between 2014 and 2024 on urban sprawl in medium-sized cities to identify the extent to which literature incorporates the challenges of climate change. Artificial intelligence techniques were applied when searching and reviewing academic and technical sources. The results show that scientific literature is oriented towards explanation and modelling (Geographic Information Systems (GIS), simulation, artificial intelligence), while the grey literature emphasises implementation and monitoring. Both converge in the use of GIS and complement each other: the scientific production provides diagnosis and analysis; the technical, action and applicability. This division of roles, however, creates a functional asynchrony: peer-reviewed scientific production typically operates on medium- to long-term research and publication timelines, whereas technical documentation responds to shorter decision windows and implementation deadlines. This temporal misalignment, in turn, highlights the need to reinforce implementation-oriented instruments for climate adaptation (especially in highly exposed Caribbean intermediate cities) so that rapid decision-making can more effectively draw upon and operationalise scientific evidence.
abstract_zh: 拉丁美洲中等城市，尤其是加勒比地区，因缺乏城市规划导致无序扩张，在气候紧急背景下产生严重后果。这种扩张通过两个相互交织的过程显现：“城市蔓延”——即向外、消耗土地（通常为低密度）的增长，以及“非正规住区”——指在正式规划、监管或产权框架之外开发的居住区。尽管分析上有所区分，但这两种动态在拉丁美洲和加勒比（LAC）的中等城市中频繁重叠，其边缘增长主要由非正规城市化驱动。这些城市/城市边缘区高度脆弱，亟需将气候维度纳入城市发展战略。本文分析了2014年至2024年间关于中等城市城市蔓延的科学文献与灰色文献，以识别文献在多大程度上纳入了气候变化挑战。在检索和审阅学术与技术资料时应用了人工智能技术。结果表明，科学文献侧重于解释与建模（地理信息系统（GIS）、模拟、人工智能），而灰色文献强调实施与监测。两者在GIS应用上趋于一致且相互补充：科学产出提供诊断与分析，技术产出提供行动与可操作性。然而，这种角色分工造成了功能上的异步性：同行评审的科学产出通常遵循中长期研究与发表周期，而技术文档则响应较短的决策窗口与实施期限。这种时间错位进而凸显了加强面向气候适应的实施导向工具（尤其在高度暴露的加勒比中等城市）的必要性，以便快速决策能更有效地借鉴并运用科学证据。

title: Measuring the Culture of Useful Knowledge and the Roots of Innovation
title_zh: 衡量有用知识文化及创新根源
title_primary: 衡量有用知识文化及创新根源
title_secondary: Measuring the Culture of Useful Knowledge and the Roots of Innovation
authors: Marc Klemp
official: 官方在线 2026-07-21 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: I develop a method that uses the language surrounding places, people, and other entities in dated text to measure their attributes over time, and use it to ask whether a local orientation toward useful knowledge predicts innovation and growth. Patterns of word use form a numerical map, or word embedding, in which fixed word lists define attribute scales for scoring each entity. Neither scales nor scores use outcomes, and publication dates restrict scores to prior text. Applied to 38.6 billion context-word occurrences in nearly 2.7 million English-language works from 1500-1899, the method recovers independently measured elevation and agricultural dependence and combines learning, science, practical improvement, and print in a useful-knowledge index. Within countries, a one-standard-deviation increase in the index is associated with 0.105 standard deviations higher log(1+patents) during 1980-2014 and a 3.4 percentage-point increase in the probability of any patent. The association remains 0.062 standard deviations in 7,011 cells without a recorded birthplace of a notable intellectual. An index reconstructed from pre-1750 contexts predicts 1980-2014 log patenting within countries at 0.053 standard deviations after controlling for textual coverage, with positive estimates in Europe, Asia, and Latin America. Training the embedding solely on pre-1750 text leaves the full-sample association positive. Within countries, the 1500-1899 index also predicts average nighttime light over 1992-2024 and regional GDP per capita in each region's latest available year, 2016-2020. In European cities, the pre-1750 index predicts faster post-1750 growth near coal, a complementarity concentrated in Britain. The findings support Mokyr's view of useful knowledge as a local innovative capacity and an Allen-Mokyr synthesis for Britain's coal-and-steam take-off.
abstract_zh: 我提出一种方法，利用文本中围绕地点、人物及其他实体的语言，测量其随时间变化的属性，并以此探究对实用知识的地方性取向能否预测创新与增长。词汇使用模式构成数值化地图（即词嵌入），其中固定词表定义属性标尺，用于对每个实体进行评分。标尺与评分均不依赖结果变量，且出版日期将评分限定于历史文本。将该方法应用于1500-1899年间近270万部英文著作中的386亿个上下文词汇实例后，该方法成功还原了独立测量的海拔高度与农业依赖度，并将学习、科学、实践改进与印刷术整合为实用知识指数。在国家层面，该指数每增加一个标准差，1980-2014年间log(1+专利数)提高0.105个标准差，且产生任何专利的概率上升3.4个百分点。在7011个未记录著名知识分子出生地的单元格中，该关联仍保持0.062个标准差。基于1750年前文本重建的指数，在控制文本覆盖范围后，可预测1980-2014年国家内log专利数达0.053个标准差，且欧洲、亚洲与拉丁美洲均呈现正向估计值。仅以1750年前文本训练词嵌入后，全样本关联仍保持正向。在国家层面，1500-1899年指数还可预测1992-2024年平均夜间灯光强度，以及各地区最新可用年份（2016-2020年）的区域人均GDP。在欧洲城市中，1750年前指数可预测1750年后煤炭资源附近更快的增长，这种互补性集中体现在英国。研究结果支持Mokyr关于实用知识作为地方创新能力的观点，以及英国煤炭与蒸汽腾飞的Allen-Mokyr综合解释。

title: Monetary Policy and Home Buying Inequality
title_zh: 货币政策与购房不平等
title_primary: 货币政策与购房不平等
title_secondary: Monetary Policy and Home Buying Inequality
authors: Daniel Ringo
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Does monetary policy influence who becomes a homeowner? Lower-income home buyers may be more sensitive to interest rates, at least in part because they more frequently come up against binding payment-to-income ratio constraints in credit decisions. Exploiting the timing of high-frequency observations of individual mortgage rate locks around monetary policy shocks, I find that a 1 percentage point policy-induced increase in mortgage rates lowers the presence of lower-income households in the population of home buyers by 1 to 2 percentage points immediately following the shock. Effects are substantially stronger among first-time home buyers and persist for approximately one year.
abstract_zh: 货币政策是否影响谁会成为房主？低收入购房者可能对利率更为敏感，至少部分原因在于他们在信贷决策中更频繁地面临严格的偿债收入比约束。利用货币政策冲击前后个人抵押贷款利率锁定的高频观测时机，我发现政策导致的抵押贷款利率每上升1个百分点，在冲击发生后立即会使购房者群体中低收入家庭的比例下降1至2个百分点。这一效应在首次购房者中尤为显著，并持续约一年时间。

title: Prediction Errors, Incarceration, and Violent Crime: Evidence from Linking Prosecutor Surveys to Court Records
title_zh: 预测错误、监禁与暴力犯罪：来自检察官调查与法庭记录匹配的证据
title_primary: 预测错误、监禁与暴力犯罪：来自检察官调查与法庭记录匹配的证据
title_secondary: Prediction Errors, Incarceration, and Violent Crime: Evidence from Linking Prosecutor Surveys to Court Records
authors: Emma Harrington, William Murdock, Hannah Shaffer
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Incarceration is often justified by a defendant’s risk of future crime. To what extent do biased beliefs about predictors of crime distort incarceration decisions? We survey prosecutors about how violent rearrest rates vary by defendant age and criminal history. Surveyed prosecutors make systematic errors: They underestimate the decline in rearrest with age and overestimate the increase with criminal history. By linking prosecutors’ beliefs to their quasi-randomly assigned cases, we show that prosecutors’ beliefs predict incarceration patterns by defendant age and criminal history in their cases. Finally, we find that prosecutors with more accurate beliefs simultaneously reduce violent rearrest and incarceration. (JEL D83, K14, K41, K42)
abstract_zh: 监禁通常以被告未来犯罪风险为正当理由。关于犯罪预测因素的偏见性认知在多大程度上扭曲了监禁判决？我们调查了检察官对暴力犯罪再逮捕率如何随被告年龄和犯罪记录变化的看法。受访检察官存在系统性错误：他们低估了再逮捕率随年龄下降的趋势，高估了其随犯罪记录增加的趋势。通过将检察官的认知与其准随机分配的案件相关联，我们证明检察官的认知能够预测其案件中按被告年龄和犯罪记录划分的监禁模式。最后，我们发现认知更准确的检察官能够同时降低暴力再逮捕率和监禁率。（JEL D83, K14, K41, K42）

title: The Evolution of Black-White Differences in Occupational Mobility Across Post-Civil War America
title_zh: 美国内战后黑人与白人在职业流动性差异上的演变
title_primary: 美国内战后黑人与白人在职业流动性差异上的演变
title_secondary: The Evolution of Black-White Differences in Occupational Mobility Across Post-Civil War America
authors: Durlauf, Steven, Kim, Gueyon, Lee, Dohyeon, Song, Xi
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Applied Economics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We examine long-run differences in intergenerational occupational mobility between Black and White Americans using linked censuses and survey data from 1850 to 2021. We document two main results. First, shifts in mobility dynamics, most notably for the 1940–1950 cohort, reshaped occupational structures and reduced racial segregation. Second, new measures of intergenerational persistence reveal both bottlenecks and the enduring memory in the mobility system, offering new perspectives on the role of mobility in explaining the lack of convergence in Black-White occupational outcomes.
abstract_zh: 我们利用1850年至2021年的关联人口普查与调查数据，考察了美国黑人与白人在代际职业流动性方面的长期差异。研究得出两个主要结论：第一，流动性动态的变化（尤以1940-1950年出生队列最为显著）重塑了职业结构并降低了种族隔离程度；第二，代际持续性的新测度揭示了流动性体系中的瓶颈效应与持久记忆，为理解流动性在解释黑人与白人职业结果缺乏趋同现象中的作用提供了新视角。

title: The macroeconomic impact of the Recovery and Resilience Facility: An analysis for Italy, Spain, and Greece
title_zh: 复苏与韧性基金对宏观经济的影响：意大利、西班牙和希腊的分析
title_primary: 复苏与韧性基金对宏观经济的影响：意大利、西班牙和希腊的分析
title_secondary: The macroeconomic impact of the Recovery and Resilience Facility: An analysis for Italy, Spain, and Greece
authors: Dino Pinelli
official: 官方在线 2026-07-14 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The EU Recovery and Resilience Facility was launched to support post-Covid recovery while accelerating structural transformation through investment and reform. This column provides a preliminary descriptive assessment of the macroeconomic impact of the facility in Italy, Greece, and Spain, three countries with large allocations. Using simple counterfactual comparisons, it presents evidence consistent with a positive impact on real GDP, and an even stronger impact on employment and investment in the three countries. The evidence also points to an expected positive impact on potential output in the years ahead.
abstract_zh: 欧盟复苏与韧性基金旨在支持疫情后经济复苏，同时通过投资与改革加速结构性转型。本专栏对意大利、希腊和西班牙这三个获得大额拨款的国家的基金宏观经济影响进行了初步描述性评估。通过简单的反事实比较，研究提供了与三国实际GDP正向影响相一致的证据，且对就业和投资的促进作用更为显著。证据还表明，该基金有望在未来几年对潜在产出产生积极影响。

title: Housing affordability is reshaping Europe’s social fabric
title_zh: 住房可负担性正在重塑欧洲的社会结构
title_primary: 住房可负担性正在重塑欧洲的社会结构
title_secondary: Housing affordability is reshaping Europe’s social fabric
authors: Jean-Jacques Hallaert, Iglika Vassileva
official: 官方在线 2026-07-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Housing affordability has moved to the forefront of Europe’s policy debate. While the economic literature has mostly focused on the drivers of housing unaffordability, this column examines its consequences in the EU. The authors find that increases in housing cost burdens have large adverse impacts on housing adequacy, with noticeable impacts on poverty and health. The effects on fertility and labour force participation are smaller.
abstract_zh: 住房可负担性已成为欧洲政策辩论的焦点。尽管经济学文献主要关注住房不可负担性的驱动因素，本文则探讨其在欧盟范围内的后果。作者发现，住房成本负担的增加对住房适足性产生显著的负面影响，并对贫困和健康状况造成明显冲击，而对生育率和劳动力参与率的影响则相对较小。

title: Economic Well-Being of Latino Households in the U.S.: a Scoping Review of Research on Poverty, the Safety Net, and Family Supports
title_zh: 美国拉丁裔家庭的经济福祉：贫困、安全网与家庭支持研究的范围综述
title_primary: 美国拉丁裔家庭的经济福祉：贫困、安全网与家庭支持研究的范围综述
title_secondary: Economic Well-Being of Latino Households in the U.S.: a Scoping Review of Research on Poverty, the Safety Net, and Family Supports
authors: Matthew Maury, Agustina Laurito, Lisa A. Gennetian, Kevin Kamto Sonke
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This scoping review curates empirical research on economic well-being among Latino households in peer reviewed journals from 1990 to 2025, following PRISMA guidelines and a preregistered search strategy. The search yielded more than 5,000 studies revealing a greater than five-fold increase since the early 2000s. The majority of studies examined Medicaid and health insurance and approximately half examined government benefit programs, particularly with respect to eligibility criteria and benefit receipt. Few studies examined the employment outcomes of Latinos in the context of government benefit availability and even fewer focus on Latinos and income support. A deeper content review revealed that studies examining Hispanics are typically through comparative analyses with other racial and ethnic groups. These studies find higher poverty and material hardship, and lower receipt of government benefits, among Latino families relative to non-Latino White households. Fewer studies consider heterogeneity within Hispanic populations. Research on economic well-being among Latino households, as distinct from more general investigations regarding immigrants, expanded in tandem with growth in the Latino population and shifts in social policy. Key policy-relevant open topics of research that affect Latinos include those related to tax credits, benefit generosity, employment, and considerations of mixed-citizen status households.
abstract_zh: 本范围综述遵循PRISMA指南及预注册搜索策略，梳理了1990年至2025年间同行评审期刊中关于拉美裔家庭经济福祉的实证研究。检索共获得5000余项研究，显示自21世纪初以来相关文献数量增长超过五倍。多数研究聚焦医疗补助与健康保险，约半数研究涉及政府福利项目，尤其关注资格标准与福利领取情况。探讨政府福利可及性背景下拉美裔就业结果的研究较少，聚焦拉美裔与收入支持的研究更为稀缺。深入内容审查表明，针对西班牙裔群体的研究通常采用与其他种族/族裔群体的比较分析。这些研究发现，相较于非拉美裔白人家庭，拉美裔家庭面临更高的贫困率和物质匮乏程度，且政府福利领取率较低。考虑西班牙裔群体内部异质性的研究较少。区别于针对移民的普遍性研究，关于拉美裔家庭经济福祉的研究随拉美裔人口增长及社会政策变迁而同步扩展。影响拉美裔群体的关键政策相关开放研究议题包括：税收抵免、福利慷慨度、就业问题及混合公民身份家庭的考量。

title: The uneven benefits of conservation: A spatial analysis of how different protection regimes influence local development in Polish municipalities
title_zh: 保护的不均衡收益：不同保护制度如何影响波兰地方发展的空间分析
title_primary: 保护的不均衡收益：不同保护制度如何影响波兰地方发展的空间分析
title_secondary: The uneven benefits of conservation: A spatial analysis of how different protection regimes influence local development in Polish municipalities
authors: Jakub Rok, Maciej Grodzicki, Martyna Podsiadło
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The balance between environmental protection and socioeconomic development remains a critical policy challenge. Conservation efforts may constrain local development but can also generate benefits beyond nature protection itself, with effects varying across protection regimes and spatial scales. Poland provides a compelling case for examining this trade-off, given its rapid economic growth alongside the significant expansion of protected areas (PAs) in recent decades. This study assesses the relationship between nature protection regimes and local development across Polish municipalities between 2009 and 2022. Using spatial econometric modelling (Spatial Durbin Error Model), we estimate the direct and indirect effects of national parks, nature reserves, and Natura 2000 sites on three dimensions of local development: economic, social, and infrastructural. The most consistent positive effects are observed for economic development in municipalities with a high share of national parks and Natura 2000 sites. Infrastructure-related effects are limited: only Natura 2000 areas show a positive direct effect, while negative indirect effects suggest regional competition for investment. Social impacts are predominantly negative, particularly for stricter protection regimes, and extend beyond administrative boundaries, likely reflecting integrated labour markets. These findings challenge the notion that conservation uniformly constrains economic development. Instead, they indicate that outcomes vary by protection regime and that benefits are unevenly distributed, supporting local economic growth while reinforcing social exclusion. The study underscores the need for policies that mitigate social costs and promote more equitable and territorially integrated development under expanding conservation efforts. abstract_zh: 环境保护与社会经济发展之间的平衡仍是一项关键的政策挑战。保护工作可能制约地方发展，但也可能产生超越自然保护本身的效益，且其影响因保护制度与空间尺度而异。波兰为考察这一权衡提供了典型案例，因其近年来经济快速增长的同时，保护区面积显著扩大。本研究评估了2009年至2022年间波兰各市镇自然保护制度与地方发展之间的关系。运用空间计量经济模型（空间杜宾误差模型），我们估算了国家公园、自然保护区及Natura 2000保护区对地方发展三个维度——经济、社会与基础设施——的直接与间接效应。最一致的正向效应出现在国家公园和Natura 2000保护区占比较高的市镇，其经济发展表现突出。基础设施相关效应有限：仅Natura 2000区域呈现正向直接效应，而负向间接效应则暗示区域间存在投资竞争。社会影响以负面为主，尤其在更严格的保护制度下，且影响超越行政边界，可能反映了劳动力市场的一体化特征。这些发现挑战了保护工作普遍制约经济发展的观点。相反，它们表明结果因保护制度而异，且效益分配不均，在支撑地方经济增长的同时加剧了社会排斥。本研究强调，在保护范围不断扩大的背景下，亟需制定相关政策以缓解社会成本，促进更加公平且区域一体化的协调发展。图形摘要 下载：下载高分辨率图片（200KB） 下载：下载全尺寸图片

title: The Welfare Economics of Reference Dependence
title_zh: 参考依赖的福利经济学
title_primary: 参考依赖的福利经济学
title_secondary: The Welfare Economics of Reference Dependence
authors: Daniel Reck, Arthur Seibold
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We analyze welfare under reference-dependent preferences. We decompose the first-order welfare effects of reference point and price changes into direct and behavioral effects. The sign of these effects depends on the form of reference-dependent payoffs; which effects are welfare relevant depends on whether reference dependence reflects a bias. We characterize corresponding social welfare effects in terms of estimable reduced-form parameters and normative judgments. We apply our framework to reference dependence in German workers’ retirement decisions. We find positive welfare effects of local increases in the normal retirement age (NRA) but ambiguous effects of financial incentives to postpone retirement. (JEL D91, H55, J26, J32)
abstract_zh: 我们分析了参照依赖偏好下的福利效应。将参照点与价格变化的一阶福利效应分解为直接效应和行为效应。这些效应的符号取决于参照依赖收益的具体形式；而哪些效应具有福利相关性则取决于参照依赖是否反映了某种偏差。我们通过可估计的简化形式参数和规范性判断来刻画相应的社会福利效应。将分析框架应用于德国工人退休决策中的参照依赖现象，研究发现：当地正常退休年龄（NRA）的提高带来正向福利效应，但延迟退休的财务激励措施产生的福利效应则具有不确定性。（JEL分类号：D91, H55, J26, J32）

title_zh: 信息与避孕措施可及性在青少年怀孕中的互补作用
title_primary: 信息与避孕措施可及性在青少年怀孕中的互补作用
title_secondary: The Complementary Role of Information and Contraceptive Access in Teen Pregnancy
authors: Sevin Kaytan, Stwarth Piedra-Bonilla, Tom Zohar
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We investigate how information frictions affect the efficacy of contraception provision programs. We study a Costa Rican initiative that combined free access to long-acting reversible contraceptives and a tailored information campaign to correct for baseline misinformation. Using administrative data and geographic variation in the initiative, we find a 16% decrease in the teen birth rate. We show information complements access – an extra year of exposure to the information campaign is equivalent to the effect of contraception access alone. Using surveys on sexual behavior, we show the policy changed the information source from personal networks to healthcare professionals, amending misinformation on sexual health.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了信息摩擦如何影响避孕提供项目的有效性。我们考察了哥斯达黎加的一项举措，该举措结合了长效可逆避孕药的免费获取和针对性的信息宣传，以纠正基线信息偏差。利用行政数据和该举措的地理差异，我们发现青少年生育率下降了16%。我们表明信息与获取渠道具有互补性——额外一年的信息宣传接触相当于仅提供避孕药具的效果。通过性行为调查，我们显示该政策将信息来源从个人社交网络转向医疗专业人员，从而修正了性健康方面的错误信息。

title: Bank Regulation and the Rise of Nonbank Intermediation
title_zh: 银行监管与非银行中介的兴起
title_primary: 银行监管与非银行中介的兴起
title_secondary: Bank Regulation and the Rise of Nonbank Intermediation
authors: Celso Brunetti, Christoph Frei
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies how financial conditions affect research and development (R&D) by firms specialized in green innovation. Using U.S. patent data matched with Compustat, we identify “green innovators” as firms with a high cumulative share of green patents. Although they account for a small share of total green patenting, these firms occupy central positions in the green-innovation ecosystem. Estimating firm-level impulse responses to exogenous changes in broad financial conditions, we find that tightening has a disproportionately large and persistent negative effect on the R&D of specialized green innovators. In contrast, R&D by diversified innovators and non-innovators responds only weakly. Green innovators are younger, smaller, and more dependent on external finance, suggesting that financial tightening introduces a systematic bias against upstream green technological development.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了非银行金融中介的兴起及其对系统性风险的影响。我们构建了一个包含银行与非银行金融机构（NBFIs）的结构性网络模型，将中介活动分解为两个渠道：由银行资产负债表约束驱动的能力渠道，以及反映非银行金融机构融资依赖性的依赖渠道。利用美国银行保密监管数据，我们估计了关键结构性参数并量化了这两个渠道。研究发现，银行与非银行金融机构之间中介活动的波动主要由依赖渠道解释，其中非银行金融机构脆弱性的变化成为主导驱动因素。我们证明，非银行金融中介可能通过融资互联性放大冲击。

title: Prompted Choice and Organ Donor Registrations: Quasi-Experimental Evidence from Italy
title_zh: 提示选择与器官捐献登记：来自意大利的准实验证据
title_primary: 提示选择与器官捐献登记：来自意大利的准实验证据
title_secondary: Prompted Choice and Organ Donor Registrations: Quasi-Experimental Evidence from Italy
authors: Omar Martin Fieles-Ahmad, Selina Schulze Spuentrup
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We examine the effects of introducing prompted choice on organ donation behavior. Applying a generalized difference-in-differences design, we take advantage of the gradual roll-out of a policy in Italy that integrated the question of organ donation preference into the process of identity card renewal. Our findings show that municipalities prompting the question saw a significant increase in consent registrations, although individuals retained the option to abstain from making a choice. We also provide novel evidence that regions with higher levels of registered consent have higher cadaveric organ donation rates.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了引入提示选择对器官捐赠行为的影响。采用广义双重差分法，我们利用意大利一项逐步推行的政策——将器官捐赠偏好问题整合到身份证更新流程中——进行分析。研究结果表明，实施提示选择的城市中，同意登记数量显著增加，尽管个人仍保留不做出选择的权利。我们还提供了新的证据，表明同意登记率较高的地区，其遗体器官捐赠率也更高。

title: Beyond land access: How agency mediates the effect of land tenure security on youth agricultural entrepreneurship in Benin?
title_zh: 超越土地获取：代理权如何中介土地权属保障对贝宁青年农业创业的影响
title_primary: 超越土地获取：代理权如何中介土地权属保障对贝宁青年农业创业的影响
title_secondary: Beyond land access: How agency mediates the effect of land tenure security on youth agricultural entrepreneurship in Benin?
authors: Soulé Akinhola Adéchian, Christine Ogoudou, Mohamed Nasser Baco
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Land tenure security is widely recognized as a key condition for agricultural investment, yet its role in fostering youth entrepreneurship remains insufficiently theorized. Using survey data from 200 rural youth in Benin, this study examines how land tenure security influences entrepreneurial engagement and through which mechanisms. Drawing on an agency-based framework, we argue that secure land access alone is insufficient to stimulate entrepreneurship unless it strengthens young people’s capacity to act, decide, and invest. Structural equation modeling shows that land tenure security has a positive but modest direct effect on agricultural entrepreneurship, while its strongest influence operates indirectly through youth agency, which emerges as a central mediating mechanism. Youth who perceive greater control over land, stronger social recognition, and higher decision-making autonomy are significantly more likely to engage in entrepreneurial activities. By contrast, restrictive social norms undermine agency and entrepreneurial engagement even in contexts of relatively secure land access. These findings advance entrepreneurship and development scholarship by challenging asset-centered and purely institutional explanations of entrepreneurship, and by demonstrating that institutional reforms shape entrepreneurial outcomes primarily through their effects on agency. The study highlights the need to combine land reforms with interventions that strengthen youth capabilities, aspirations, and social legitimacy in order to foster inclusive rural entrepreneurship.
abstract_zh: 土地权属保障被广泛认为是农业投资的关键条件，但其在促进青年创业方面的作用仍未得到充分的理论化探讨。本研究利用来自贝宁200名农村青年的调查数据，考察土地权属保障如何影响创业参与及其作用机制。基于能动性分析框架，我们认为，仅靠有保障的土地获取并不足以激发创业，除非它能增强青年行动、决策和投资的能力。结构方程模型显示，土地权属保障对农业创业具有正向但适度的直接影响，而其最强的影响则通过青年能动性间接发挥作用，后者成为核心的中介机制。那些对土地控制感更强、社会认可度更高以及决策自主性更大的青年，参与创业活动的可能性显著更高。相比之下，即使土地获取相对有保障，限制性的社会规范也会削弱能动性和创业参与。这些发现推进了创业与发展研究，挑战了以资产为中心和纯制度性的创业解释，并表明制度变革主要通过其对能动性的影响来塑造创业结果。本研究强调，需要将土地改革与增强青年能力、志向和社会合法性的干预措施相结合，以促进包容性的农村创业。

abstract: Submissions increased in 2025 to 386 original manuscripts, similar to levels preceding the Covid period. The Journal's acceptance rate increased from 11% to 13%, which contrasts with rates of less than 10% in the preceding few years. The Journal's Impact Factor increased from 3.4 to 4.2, which compares favourably with similar field journals. This is my final report as Editor‐in‐Chief, with Frederic Ang due to succeed me following publication of the final edition of the year, which will contain principally invited articles marking the centenary of the Agricultural Economics Society.
abstract_zh: 2025年投稿量增至386篇原创稿件，与新冠疫情前水平相当。本刊录用率从11%升至13%，与此前数年低于10%的比率形成对比。期刊影响因子从3.4提升至4.2，在同类领域期刊中表现优异。这是我作为主编的最终报告，弗雷德里克·昂将在本年度最后一期出版后接任我的职务，该期将主要收录为纪念农业经济学会成立一百周年而特邀撰写的文章。

title: Here comes the rain: Precipitation shocks and economic outcomes in Ecuador
title_zh: 降雨来袭：厄瓜多尔的降水冲击与经济产出
title_primary: 降雨来袭：厄瓜多尔的降水冲击与经济产出
title_secondary: Here comes the rain: Precipitation shocks and economic outcomes in Ecuador
authors: Gustavo Canavire-Bacarreza, Alejandro Puerta-Cuartas, Andrey Ramos
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines how precipitation shocks affect poverty in Ecuador. Using gridded monthly precipitation data for 2007-2024, we construct parish-level measures of excess and deficit precipitation and link them to household socioeconomic data from the National Survey of Employment, Unemployment, and Underemployment (ENEMDU). Our empirical estimates show that both excess and deficit precipitation increase the likelihood of poverty among workers in the primary sector (agriculture and mining), consistent with disruptions to agricultural production and local infrastructure. By contrast, in the tertiary sector (commerce and services), precipitation shocks lower the probability of poverty, plausibly reflecting heightened demand for health and social assistance, transportation, logistics, and related services during emergency response and recovery phases. We identify per-capita labor income and per-capita final household income as primary transmission channels, with magnitudes conditioned by formality status, location (urban versus rural), self-employment, and the recurrence of shocks. These findings underscore the potential of targeted sector-specific policies to mitigate the poverty impacts of weather shocks.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了降水冲击如何影响厄瓜多尔的贫困状况。利用2007-2024年网格化月降水数据，我们构建了教区层面的过度降水与降水不足指标，并将其与全国就业、失业与不充分就业调查（ENEMDU）中的家庭社会经济数据相关联。实证估计显示，过度降水与降水不足均增加了第一产业（农业与采矿业）从业者陷入贫困的可能性，这与农业生产及当地基础设施受到干扰的情况相符。相比之下，在第三产业（商业与服务业），降水冲击降低了贫困概率，这很可能反映了在应急响应与恢复阶段，对健康与社会援助、交通、物流及相关服务需求的增加。我们识别出人均劳动收入与人均最终家庭收入为主要传导渠道，其影响程度受正规就业状态、地理位置（城市与农村）、自雇状态及冲击反复发生情况的调节。这些发现凸显了针对特定部门制定政策以减轻天气冲击对贫困影响的潜力。

title: Closing Gender Gaps Through Workplace Diversity: The Intergenerational Effects of World War I
title_zh: 通过职场多样性缩小性别差距：第一次世界大战的代际效应
title_primary: 通过职场多样性缩小性别差距：第一次世界大战的代际效应
title_secondary: Closing Gender Gaps Through Workplace Diversity: The Intergenerational Effects of World War I
authors: Abhay Aneja, Silvia Farina, Guo Xu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This article combines personnel records of the U.S. government with census data to study how exposure to greater female representation at work can persistently reduce intergenerational gender gaps in labour market outcomes. Exploiting city-by-department variation in the sudden expansion of female employment during World War I, we find that daughters of civil servants exposed to female co-workers are more likely to work later in life. This intergenerational effect operates through exposed fathers and extends beyond the public sector, reducing the earnings gap by 12%. Consistent with a broader shift in attitudes towards working women, exposure to female co-workers also made male civil servants more likely to marry working women. We show that cities exposed to larger increases in female federal workers saw persistently higher female labour force participation in both the public and the private sector. Increasing gender representation within the public sector can thus have broader labour market implications.
abstract_zh: 本文结合美国政府人事档案与人口普查数据，研究工作中女性代表性提升如何持续缩小劳动力市场结果的代际性别差距。利用第一次世界大战期间女性就业突然扩张的城市-部门差异，我们发现，接触过女性同事的公务员的女儿在日后更有可能进入职场。这种代际效应通过受影响的父亲发挥作用，并延伸至公共部门之外，使收入差距缩小12%。与对职业女性态度整体转变相一致的是，接触女性同事也使男性公务员更有可能与职业女性结婚。研究表明，接触女性联邦雇员数量增长更大的城市，其公共与私营部门的女性劳动参与率均持续提高。因此，提升公共部门内的性别代表性可能对更广泛的劳动力市场产生深远影响。

title: The enduring impacts of early life exposure to heatwaves on climate governance
title_zh: 早期热浪暴露对气候治理的持久影响
title_primary: 早期热浪暴露对气候治理的持久影响
title_secondary: The enduring impacts of early life exposure to heatwaves on climate governance
authors: Jingbo Cui, Chunhua Wang, Zhenxuan Wang
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines the enduring effects of early-life exposure to heatwaves on the climate governance of local political leaders. We compile detailed biographical information on city mayors and party secretaries in China and combine it with comprehensive data on carbon emissions, economic outcomes, and policies for over 2800 counties from 2000 to 2017. We find that counties governed by officials who experienced heatwaves in their early life exhibit about a 1% reduction in carbon emissions relative to those governed by officials without such exposure. The effect is driven primarily by mayors, officials with more intense or repeated heatwave exposure, and cities with less industrialized economic structures. Further analysis provides suggestive evidence that these officials are more likely to implement carbon pricing and emission abatement policies, as well as policies with clear targets, enforcement, and mandatory language. Their governance reshapes local economic structures by constraining the activity and entry of emission-intensive manufacturing firms, a pattern further supported by firm-level evidence of lower carbon emissions.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了早期生活中经历热浪对地方政治领导人气候治理的持久影响。我们汇编了中国城市市长及市委书记的详细传记信息，并将其与2000年至2017年间超过2800个县的碳排放、经济成果及政策综合数据相结合。研究发现，由早期生活中经历过热浪的官员治理的县，其碳排放量相较于未经历此类暴露的官员所治理的县，约减少1%。这一效应主要由市长、经历更强烈或更频繁热浪暴露的官员，以及工业化程度较低的经济结构的城市所驱动。进一步分析提供了提示性证据，表明这些官员更可能实施碳定价和减排政策，以及具有明确目标、执行机制和强制性语言的政策。他们的治理通过限制排放密集型制造业企业的活动和进入，重塑了地方经济结构，这一模式也得到了企业层面碳排放降低的证据支持。
